title: Tasers
description: Adds JP inspired Tasers to minecraft
body:
This was my first proper mod so beware. 

In jurassic park there are cool looking tasers that they use for the dinosaurs and thought it would be cool to add to minecraft. This mod is intended to be used with a dinosaur mod like the up and coming project nublar or you can use it in regular minecraft. My thoughts were to use it on them and be able to apply a slowness effect aswell as other effects to them that way you have time to run. 

There is a upgraded version of the Taser that it focused on doing more damage that is blue.

P.S use JEI for the recipes. Have FUN
